hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA must bind an exact manifest and prove complete guarded states, forward/rollback inversion, target bijection, and package disjointness.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable source snapshot and passes exact source-state preflight in package order.
Every forward and rollback operation file passes a strict-noop parser dry-run before mutation.
REPL targets have zero block-entity intersections and a fresh same-moment live entity gate has zero blockers.
Forward execution uses strict-noop journals; a failed package triggers the exact inverse for the partial package and every committed package in reverse order.
A fresh immutable post snapshot must prove every reverse-order rollback guard, which simultaneously verifies exact intended post-state and reversibility.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed safety check blocks only its exact release.
